entities.name: Manila Galleon Trade
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Manila Galleon route connected Asia to the Americas via the Pacific — the first regular transpacific trade. Chinese silk and porcelain traveled to Mexico; Mexican silver flowed to China.
